info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Switch Operation Review-spec
info.description: The Market Data Switch Operation Review API facilitates the submission of reviews for market data switch operations. This API enables users to send feedback or validation checks related to specific market data transactions identified by a unique parameter. It is primarily used by financial institutions, market analysts, and compliance teams to ensure the accuracy and reliability of market data management. Through this API, developers can integrate seamless review processes into their applications, enhancing oversight and accountability in financial operations.

post.summary: Create a review for a market data switch operation.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for the specified market data switch operation identified by RES-100045. A review can help evaluate the performance and usability of the operation, contributing to future improvements.
